_comment: Finer-grid repeat of the fine time-resolved runs of record (mu_sweeps_full_Nx512_hp025_T3p125_NyF5_np18_Nsave125: n_periods 18, dx = 18 L / 512 = 0.035 L, the large sweep's spacing). Here n_periods 10 at the same 512 points gives dx = 10 L / 512 = 0.020 L, 1.8 times finer (points per stripe wavelength at mu 0.90: 45 instead of 25), everything else as before: dt 0.025, 125 frames to t = 3.125, Ny_factor 5, Rscale 0.5, full-width crop. Cheap: 125 steps per angle. n_periods must stay even (it counts half periods pi / k1 along x; the 21 Sep set 0921_tall_fine used 9, which makes the initial condition antiperiodic across the box edge; that set was not used in any result of record). Run: python run_sh_pgb_zigzag.py --config fine_np10_1031.json, then cells_motion_anim.py v1.3 and nucleation_migration.py v1.3 on the new folder with the 29 and 28 Oct arguments, and compare cm_counts.csv and the migration tables core by core with the np18 results: the birth separation (one grid cell at np18), the 3V + 2X transient, the walk speed and the timing of the one-turn reading.
